growth.share.desc_guest.zh: 把月光塔罗分享给朋友 —— 朋友通过你的链接进来，你们 各得 +1 次免费解读；登录后邀请各得 +2 次、每天分享最多再领 3 次 👑。

growth.horo.f_overall_1.zh: 整体节奏偏顺，适合把拖延的事推进一下。
growth.horo.f_overall_1.en: The overall rhythm is smooth — good day to move stalled tasks forward.

growth.horo.f_love_1.zh: 适合主动一点，TA 在等你的信号。
growth.horo.f_love_1.en: Be a little bolder — they're waiting for your signal.

growth.horo.f_career_1.zh: 适合推进卡了很久的那件事。
growth.horo.f_career_1.en: Good day to push forward that long-stuck task.

growth.horo.f_wealth_1.en: Steady income luck; don't get greedy with windfalls.

growth.horo.f_overall_2.zh: 今天的直觉很准，跟着感觉走不容易错。
growth.horo.f_overall_2.en: Your intuition is sharp today; following your gut won't steer you wrong.

growth.horo.f_love_2.zh: 单身者今天桃花藏在朋友的朋友里。
growth.horo.f_love_2.en: Singles: romance may hide among a friend's friends.

growth.horo.f_career_2.zh: 会议上大胆说出想法，会被看见。
growth.horo.f_career_2.en: Speak up boldly in meetings — you'll be noticed.

growth.horo.f_wealth_2.zh: 适合整理账单，会发现省钱空间。
growth.horo.f_wealth_2.en: Good day to review bills — you'll find ways to save.

growth.horo.f_overall_3.zh: 宜稳不宜急，守住节奏就是赢。
growth.horo.f_overall_3.en: Steady wins: hold your pace instead of rushing.

growth.horo.f_love_3.zh: 有伴者适合一次走心的聊天，别只聊琐事。
growth.horo.f_love_3.en: Coupled: have a heart-to-heart instead of just small talk.

growth.horo.f_career_3.zh: 贵人运在线，别不好意思求助。
growth.horo.f_career_3.en: Helpful people are around; don't be shy to ask.

growth.horo.f_wealth_3.zh: 小额尝试可以，大手笔再等等。
growth.horo.f_wealth_3.en: Small experiments are fine; hold off on big moves.

growth.horo.f_overall_4.zh: 会有小确幸找上门，记得抬头看看。
growth.horo.f_overall_4.en: Small joys are coming your way — remember to look up.

growth.horo.f_love_4.zh: 先把自己照顾好，爱情会跟着来。
growth.horo.f_love_4.en: Take care of yourself first, and love will follow.

growth.horo.f_career_4.zh: 细节决定成败，今天多检查一遍。

growth.horo.f_wealth_4.zh: 今天适合谈加薪或接副业线索。
growth.horo.f_wealth_4.en: Good day to negotiate a raise or chase side-gig leads.

growth.horo.f_overall_5.zh: 适合复盘和整理，为明天蓄力。
growth.horo.f_overall_5.en: Good for reviewing and tidying up, saving energy for tomorrow.

growth.horo.f_love_5.zh: 旧人旧事别回头，向前看更甜。
growth.horo.f_love_5.en: Don't look back at old flames — ahead is sweeter.

growth.horo.f_career_5.zh: 适合学习新技能，吸收特别快。
growth.horo.f_career_5.en: Great for learning new skills; you'll absorb them fast.

growth.horo.f_wealth_5.zh: 冲动消费预警，购物车先冷静一晚。
growth.horo.f_wealth_5.en: Impulse-buying alert: let the cart cool off overnight.

growth.horo.f_overall_6.zh: 别被琐事带跑，抓住一件重要的事就好。
growth.horo.f_overall_6.en: Don't let trivial things distract you; just nail one important thing.

growth.horo.f_love_6.zh: 一个小小的关心，比一百句情话管用。
growth.horo.f_love_6.en: One small act of care beats a hundred sweet words.

growth.horo.f_career_6.zh: 保持耐心，大项目正在悄悄成形。
growth.horo.f_career_6.en: Stay patient — a big project is quietly taking shape.

growth.horo.f_wealth_6.zh: 朋友带来的消息里藏着机会。
growth.horo.f_wealth_6.en: News from a friend may hide an opportunity.
